text_block_list.text:
—The outcome is decided. Standing in the 
winner's circle of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Kyaa, King!! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King Halo! Kiiing!!
(Wooooaaaaah------!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad, these cheers. Voices truly 
befitting the very top.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I lost, huh... ...I really... didn't want 
to lose...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, there's somewhere I'd like to 
go.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Shall we?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...King-chan...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for taking a moment of your time 
together. There is just something I 
absolutely must say.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—To tell you the truth, for a time, I 
hated all of you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I thought things would go so much better 
if only you weren't here. I kept wondering 
why you had to get in my way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why did I have to debut in the same year 
as you guys...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Still, now I think...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I was born in this generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because you were all there, I felt like I 
couldn't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Every time I thought about not wanting to 
lose, it made me so frustrated, so 
unbearably frustrated, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If not for all of you, I don't think I 
would have ever found the resolve to act.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because you were all there...! I was able 
to walk my very own path...! So, um...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for competing against me. 
Thank you for being my rival...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: King-chan...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...That's... all I had to say. Well 
then...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You're such an idiot, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Did you think you were the only one who 
felt that way?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I've always thought so too. That I'm so 
glad I debuted in the same generation as 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone was my rival, that's how 
I was able to become strong.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I got to debut in the same 
year as everyone, and compete alongside 
them...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Special Week...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Spe-chan and King are putting off 
this really wholesome vibe, but you 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Did you two say that yourselves and then 
immediately forget it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We're from the same generation, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's no way it ends like this. Let's 
race again next time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's right. Come to think of 
it, we're from the same generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We'll compete against each other over and 
over from now on, won't we? Again and 
again, as many times as it takes...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Then I definitely won't let you beat me 
next time, either! Because King here is 
the one worthy of first place!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oho, someone's talking big~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh, I'll totally say it!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You two better bring everything you've got 
next time too! Ohohoho! Ohohoho!!

...And the wind blew along with the sound 
of the girls' laughter.

That wind pushes forward, ever forward. 
Moving toward a new season, advancing into 
a new year.

Every single person there— Can become the 
protagonist, starting right from this 
racetrack.
